summary: Frontend testing of ingredient picker feature in recipe creation modal. All core functionalities are working correctly.

issues: Category filters (frais, marée, etc.) show 0 results - likely data categorization issue, not UI bug. Products may not have categories assigned.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Ingredient picker feature fully tested. All 9 test cases passed. Navigation path: Production (bottom nav) > Productions tab > Nouvelle Production button. The picker uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
